g.text: Multi-Repo Control Plane & Bounded Execution Engine Wireframe
⚡ CONTROL PLANE (Workspace Control, CLI Dispatcher & Multi-Repo Intake)
Handoffs in durable files, not chat!
Never committed to git · Never in image
⚙️ DATA PLANE (Bounded Runtime Pool — 5 Bounded Slots)
Multi-Repo Concurrency: repo-1 (FEAT-42, CHORE-19), repo-2 (FIX-108), repo-3 (FEAT-7) in parallel slots
🧠 CONTEXT & STATE MODEL (LSM Memory Engine & Stage Handoffs)
Zero reliance on volatile LLM chat history
O(1) Snapshot restore on topic switch
